exitZeroWithBlocker: verify:ci: exits 0 while verify:full exits 1. The wrapper step `pnpm verify:full && ...` should propagate the 1; on Windows pwsh the `&&` propagation semantics for `pnpm run` may differ from POSIX. This is the most serious wrapper-truthfulness finding.
